metadata.title: José Véliz | Freelance full stack engineer · Web, SaaS & AI agents
metadata.description: Freelance full stack engineer. I turn your idea into a product in production: websites, stores, SaaS and AI agents, with clear scope, timeline and deliverables.

hero.sentence: I'm José Manuel, a freelance full stack engineer. I turn your idea into a product that works, in weeks.

services.title: What I build

groups.title: MVP in 6–8 weeks
groups.description: From idea to a product in your users' hands: a web or mobile app designed, built and deployed with a fixed scope from day one.

groups.title: AI agents
groups.description: Agents and automations connected to your product and your data, taking on support, analysis and repetitive operations.

groups.title: SaaS dashboard
groups.description: Your product's control panel built from scratch: metrics, roles, billing and integrations on an architecture ready to grow.

process.title: Your project, in writing
process.intro: Choose what you need and read the itinerary: each stage, how long it takes and what you hold at the end.

stages.title: Definition and scope
stages.deliverables: Requirements document (SRS), time and cost estimate, access to the kanban board

stages.title: Design and architecture
stages.deliverables: Mockups and design system, architecture diagram, database design

stages.title: Development in sprints
stages.deliverables: GitHub repository, a release at the end of every sprint you can test

stages.title: Delivery and deployment
stages.deliverables: Source code, technical docs, user manuals, production set up

process.supportDetail: Monthly hours for bugs, infrastructure and questions
process.total: In your hands: the product in production
process.note: A rough estimate. The final plan comes out of the definition call.

about.title: About me
about.intro: I work with founders and businesses that need to go digital. Every dollar counts, so I work with a fixed scope, frequent releases and results you can see.
